title: Nasi Goreng
subtitle: Indonesian fried rice with kecap manis and a fried egg
excerpt: Indonesian fried rice made with day-old rice, shrimp paste, kecap manis, and vegetables, topped with a fried egg and prawn crackers. The national dish of Indonesia.

recipe.sourceNotes: Nasi goreng is the national dish of Indonesia and one of the most widely eaten dishes across Southeast Asia, with regional variants across Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and the Netherlands (where it arrived via the Dutch colonial connection to Indonesia). The essential distinction from other fried rice dishes is the use of kecap manis, a thick, sweet Indonesian soy sauce, and terasi (shrimp paste), which gives the dish its characteristic deep, savoury base note. Nasi goreng is traditionally a dish for using up leftover rice: freshly cooked rice is too moist and clumps in the wok.

recipeTools.notes: Or the largest frying pan available, over the highest heat.

content.text: Day-old cold rice is essential: fresh rice is too wet and will steam rather than fry. Work on the highest heat your hob can produce and do everything quickly. Kecap manis is available in most large supermarkets and all Asian food shops. If unavailable, mix 2 tablespoons of soy sauce with 1 tablespoon of soft brown sugar as a substitute. The shrimp paste should be crumbled into the oil before the other ingredients go in: this blooms the flavour and removes the raw edge.

content.text: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in the wok over the highest heat until smoking. Add the shrimp paste and break up in the oil for 30 seconds. Add the shallots, garlic, and chilli. Stir-fry for 2 minutes until fragrant.

Add the prawns and stir-fry for 2 minutes until pink. Add the cold rice and break up any clumps. Stir-fry over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, pressing the rice against the wok, until heated through and beginning to crisp in places.

Add the kecap manis and soy sauce. Toss to coat evenly. Cook for 1 minute more. Fry the eggs separately in the remaining oil. Serve the rice in bowls topped with the fried egg, sliced spring onion, cucumber slices, and prawn crackers if you have them.
